predicate.verdict_note: No blocking defect. Base 87021c9962 is the merge-base against the LOCAL origin/main ref: git fetch was refused by the lane hook, so it may be stale; the head is exact. This receipt binds the whole PR diff 87021c9962..67ac2e4165 and covers the delta 67ac2e4165 on top of bc1fbd4a9f. The delta is behaviour-preserving: five printf | grep -q sites became here-strings (check_no_pipe_into_grep_q 60 of 60), LREC and RREC equal the old receipt names in both modes, and the two re-anchored mutants still bite; four hand mutants of the new variables were planted by the primary and all four turned the models_t1 table red. The five advisory items from bc1fbd4a9f still stand on this head (a sibling branch, origin/la-71/nightly-ticket-gaps, carries fixes for some of them and is not part of this PR). New advisory items: YAML single-quoted scalars are not stripped by the policy readers (found by agy, reproduced here; two readers fail closed, one prints the quotes) and the same in the has-entry awk; the receipt name now has two sources in models_t1.sh (RSUF at the judge, LREC and RREC at the legs). Every touched guard was run at this head: policy self-test 46 rows, models_nightly 79 rows and 29 of 29 mutants, release_readiness 44, pre-flight 98, tag-step self-test, draft guard 27 mutants, models_t1 guard 65 rows and 35 mutants, bump-body 17 rows, prepare_bump self-test; all rc 0. The workflow edit (models-tickets job) was read but not run.
